native_sensitivity.scope: BF16 batch-shape sensitivity audit. Disagreements are reported, not hidden or used to select a checkpoint.

definitions.stopped_answer_correct: Last returned state matches the N-step reference; wrong length is allowed; malformed responses fail.
definitions.nominal_final_correct: State at position N is correct; a missing position or malformed output fails.
definitions.complete_trajectory: All first N generated states are correct; extra states may follow; missing states or malformed output fail.
definitions.exact_stop: Well-formed response contains exactly N states and ends with EOS.
definitions.joint_success: Last returned state correct and exact termination.
definitions.strict_success: All first N states correct and exact termination.
definitions.intervals: Pointwise Wilson intervals for per-depth graph rates; saved stratified whole-graph bootstrap intervals for count cohorts.
definitions.termination: Mutually exclusive: malformed takes priority, then token cap without EOS, then early/exact/late EOS.
definitions.training: Full-vocabulary response-token CE including EOS, averaged within each example then across examples; validation is teacher forced.
definitions.scope: Audited free generations on the opened 1350-graph panel. These are parsed state positions, not recurrent loops. BF16 batched scores; native audit agrees on scores, not every token continuation.
